issues.issue: [fixed] The expenditure total 10,791,576 is filed under schedule 'Budget and Actual - General Fund', but only 914,872 of detail items carry that schedule name. The other 9,876,704 is on items tagged 'Administrative Expenditures' (1,100,905, p4), 'Project and Improvement Costs and Capital Outlay' (5,094,751, p5) and 'Personnel Costs' (3,681,048, p6). The validator matches by fund+schedule+section, so this does not tie. Those three schedules' printed totals (p4 1,100,905; p5 5,094,751; p6 3,681,048) are not in detail_totals. Either add those three totals and cut the p3 entry down to depreciation and capital outlay, or put every expenditure item under one schedule name.
